//ClientIds: The client IDs this API pins in its authorization rules. Each must equal the same key under ClientIds in src/IDP/appsettings.json (where the IDP registers the client); a missing one stops the start-up.
//ConnectionStrings: AuditDbConnection holds a password, so it is NOT in this file (which goes into the container image): Development reads it from appsettings.Development.json, everywhere else from the environment (ConnectionStrings__AuditDbConnection) or a secret store. Missing = the API refuses to start.

Audit.//VerifyIntervalMinutes: How often the whole hash chain is re-verified (tampering then shows on /health/ready and /metrics).
